self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Sky-Piercing Fang (R1): after using Elemental Burst, Normal and Charged Attacks deal additional DMG equal to 20% of ATK for 12s. Movement SPD/ATK SPD bonuses not modeled (non-combat). Modeled as a supplementary hit — its own rotation target (weapon/normalExtraHit + weapon/chargedExtraHit), weight = how many times it procs; physical, scales with ATK and CRIT only, no DMG% bonuses. Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).
